Utterbar v0.15.6 sherpa-onnx vendored bundle (DirectML-enabled)
================================================================

Build date:        2026-04-29
Build host:        Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, MSVC 14.44.35207, CMake 4.3
Build profile:     release (cmake-rs default)
Source target dir: C:\ut-target\release\build\sherpa-rs-sys-01cc0909d7479f22\out\lib\

sherpa-rs:         0.6.8
sherpa-rs-sys:     0.6.8 (with feature "directml")
sherpa-onnx:       extracted from sherpa-rs-sys-0.6.8 vendored source,
                   with cmake/show-info.cmake patched per
                   src-tauri/vendor/sherpa-onnx-patches/show-info.cmake
                   (wmic call removed for Windows 11 24H2+ compatibility).

ONNX Runtime:      1.14.20230224.5.c57cf37
                   (ProductVersion from onnxruntime.dll metadata)
                   Source: microsoft.ml.onnxruntime.directml.1.14.1.nupkg
                   (URL pinned in sherpa-rs-sys-0.6.8/sherpa-onnx/cmake/
                    onnxruntime-win-x64-directml.cmake)

DirectML:          1.15.0+240708-1738.1.dml-1.15.a106403
                   (ProductVersion from DirectML.dll metadata)
                   Source: Microsoft.AI.DirectML.1.15.0.nupkg
                   (URL + sha pinned in sherpa-rs-sys-0.6.8/sherpa-onnx/cmake/
                    onnxruntime-win-x64-directml.cmake)

Build procedure:   See Utterbar Windows App/scripts/build-directml-bundle.ps1
                   and the "Bundle rebuild" section of RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md.
                   Production app builds DO NOT compile sherpa-onnx; they
                   link against this vendored bundle via SHERPA_LIB_PATH.

DirectML EP layout: EMBEDDED. ORT 1.14.1 statically links the DML execution
                    provider into onnxruntime.dll. No
                    onnxruntime_providers_dml.dll satellite is shipped.
                    runtime_capabilities() probes for either layout
                    (legacy satellite OR PE-export of
                    OrtSessionOptionsAppendExecutionProvider_DML on
                    onnxruntime.dll).

----------------------------------------------------------------
Files mirrored at src-tauri/runtime/ (for tauri.conf.json bundle.resources)
----------------------------------------------------------------

DirectML.dll                                                  same SHA
onnxruntime.dll                                               same SHA
onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll                              same SHA
sherpa-onnx-c-api.dll                                         same SHA
sherpa-onnx-cxx-api.dll                                       same SHA

These five DLLs get unpacked alongside utterbar.exe at install time.
Production builds DO NOT use the .lib import libraries — those exist
only in vendor/sherpa-onnx/lib/ for the link step.

----------------------------------------------------------------
Step 1 / Step 2 evidence
----------------------------------------------------------------

Build feasibility verified by the v0.15.6 Step 1 + Step 2 experiments
(memory: v0156_directml_step0_results.md, v0156_directml_step2_results.md).

Step 2 model smoke matrix on Jay's machine (30 s clip, all 8 cells PASS,
zero crashes):

  Whisper Small         CPU 0.143  DML 0.183   (DML 0.78x CPU short-clip)
  Whisper Medium        CPU 0.362  DML 0.200   (DML 1.81x CPU)
  Whisper Large v3      CPU 0.734  DML 0.267   (DML 2.75x CPU)
  Parakeet TDT v3 int8  CPU 0.086  DML 0.060   (DML 1.43x CPU)

Real-meeting RTF for v0.15.6 release notes will be measured by the
validation matrix immediately before publish.
